claims.statement: ANSE.DESIDR2wCDM.E2_pos (for 0 < Om < 1, z >= 0 and every real w, Om(1+z)^3 + (1-Om)(1+z)^(3(1+w)) > 0 (real power)) is kernel-verified with axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx, no smuggled axiom.
ANSE.DESIDR2wCDM.E_pos (for 0 < Om < 1, z >= 0 and every real w, E(z) = sqrt(E2) > 0) is kernel-verified with axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx, no smuggled axiom.

ANSE.DESIDR2wCDM.E_w_neg_one (for every Om, z: the wCDM E at w = -1 equals ANSE.BAOFlatLCDM.E Om z (the DR1 flat-LCDM E)) is kernel-verified with axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx, no smuggled axiom.

ANSE.DESIDR2wCDM.E_strictMonoOn_of_neg_one_le (for 0 < Om < 1 and w >= -1, E is strictly increasing on [0, inf)) is kernel-verified with axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx, no smuggled axiom.

ANSE.DESIDR2wCDM.invE_continuousOn (for 0 < Om < 1 and every real w, t -> 1/E(t) is continuous on [0, inf)) is kernel-verified with axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx, no smuggled axiom.

ANSE.DESIDR2wCDM.Dc_strictMonoOn (for 0 < Om < 1 and every real w, D_C(z) = integral_0^z dt/E(t) is strictly increasing on [0, inf)) is kernel-verified with axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx, no smuggled axiom.

Flat-LCDM BAO-only fit of the real DESI DR2 Gaussian BAO file (13 points, 13x13 cov, sha256 = preregistered): emcee posterior Om = 0.29781 +- 0.00856, h*rd = 101.530 +- 0.732 Mpc, corr = -0.9230 (CONVERGED, 20000 steps, ESS 21170); independent grid posterior Om = 0.29783 +- 0.00863, h*rd = 101.523 +- 0.736; chi2_min = 10.271 on 11 dof.

Flat-wCDM BAO-only fit of the same DR2 file: emcee posterior Om = 0.29713 +- 0.00896, w = -0.9164 +- 0.0787, h*rd = 99.83 +- 1.73 Mpc (h*rd report-only; CONVERGED); grid posterior Om = 0.29714 +- 0.00894, w = -0.9170 +- 0.0783; chi2_min = 9.041 on 10 dof.

All preregistered positive controls pass: PC0 DR1 regression reproduces Om 0.29389 / h*rd 101.9367 / chi2 12.7405; PC1 noiseless LCDM mock |dOm| = 1.8e-11; PC2 noiseless wCDM mock |dw| = 1.2e-10; PC3 500 noisy mocks pull mean Om -0.002, std 0.970, mean chi2_min 10.60; PC4 astropy vs quad max rel diff 1.6e-15.

All preregistered negative controls fail as required: NC1 redshift permutation (every z changed) chi2 16645; NC2 DM/DH swap chi2 36338; NC3 Einstein-de Sitter chi2 1420.2 (PTE 6.2e-297); NC4 LCDM on a w=-0.7 mock chi2 11.76 > 9; NC5 20 scrambled covariances median PTE 3.4e-06 < 1e-3.

CAMB 2.0.4 background cross-check: with massless neutrinos CAMB D_M and H agree with our quad path to 2.3e-11 relative (w=-1 and w=-0.9); fitting the primary model (no radiation, no nu mass) to a noiseless CAMB 0.06 eV data vector shifts Om by +0.032 sigma, h*rd by -0.011 sigma (LCDM) and w by -0.008 sigma; Planck-2018 rdrag = 147.1027 Mpc.
Radiation sensitivity variant (Omega_r = 9.045e-05 from astropy): shifts Om by -0.046 sigma, h*rd by +0.013 sigma (LCDM) and w by -0.0016 sigma (wCDM); none exceeds the preregistered 0.3 sigma flag.
Same emcee pipeline on the DESI DR1 file (12 points): LCDM Om = 0.29498 +- 0.01469, h*rd = 101.887 +- 1.271 Mpc; wCDM Om = 0.29305, w = -0.9896, h*rd = 101.69 Mpc (both CONVERGED).

DR1->DR2 shift from our own two posteriors: Delta Om = +0.00283, Delta h*rd = -0.356 Mpc; Delta Om / sigma_nested(own = 0.01194) = 0.237, / sigma_independent(own) = 0.167. sigma_nested is an ideal-nesting approximation.
arXiv:2503.14738v3 eq.(17): DESI DR2 BAO-only flat LCDM Om = 0.2975 +- 0.0086, h*rd = (101.54 +- 0.73) Mpc, correlation coefficient r = -0.92 (posterior mean and std).
arXiv:2503.14738v3 Table V, wCDM row 'DESI' (DR2 BAO alone): Om = 0.2969 +- 0.0089, w = -0.916 +- 0.078 (marginalized posterior means); no h*rd given. Read from v3 only.
arXiv:2503.14738v3 Sec. III.C.1 (p.15): the joint LCDM fit to all DR2 tracers returns best-fit chi2/dof = 10.2/(13 - 2).
arXiv:2404.03002v3: DESI DR1 BAO alone gives flat LCDM Om = 0.295 +- 0.015, rd*h = (101.8 +- 1.3) Mpc (eq. 4.1) and flat wCDM Om = 0.293 +- 0.015, w = -0.99 +0.15/-0.13 (eq. 5.1).

Priors: arXiv:2404.03002v3 Table 2 gives flat priors Om ~ U[0.01, 0.99], rd*h ~ U[10, 1000] Mpc, w ~ U[-3, 1]; arXiv:2503.14738v3 Sec. V states its priors 'match those given in Table 2 of [38]'. That [38] = 2404.03002 is inferred from context (bibliography entry not read).

The four preregistered DR2 targets are reproduced within 0.5 published sigma with width ratios in [0.8, 1.2]: pulls DR2_LCDM_Om +0.037, DR2_LCDM_hrd_Mpc -0.013, DR2_wCDM_Om +0.026, DR2_wCDM_w -0.005; width ratios 0.995, 1.003, 1.007, 1.009.
Secondary DR2 criteria pass: chi2_min = 10.271 vs published 10.2 (|diff| <= 0.5); emcee corr(Om, h*rd) = -0.9230 vs published -0.92 (|diff| <= 0.05).

DR1 instrument checks: our DR1 posterior means sit within 0.07 published sigma of DESI DR1: DR1_LCDM_Om pull -0.0013, DR1_LCDM_hrd pull +0.0667, DR1_wCDM_Om pull +0.0033, DR1_wCDM_w pull +0.0025, DR1_wCDM_hrd pull -0.0021.

Our Delta Om = +0.00283 vs the published-derived +0.0025 (2503.14738 eq.17 minus 2404.03002 eq.4.1; DESI does not quote this difference): Delta/sigma_nested(prereg 0.01229) = 0.231; all three preregistered shift predictions pass under both sigma choices.
Preregistered overall verdict within_tolerance = true: all 14 criteria (4 pulls, 4 widths, correlation, chi2, MCMC convergence, positive controls, negative controls, sha256) are true.

The Lean definitions E2/E/Dc in formal/ANSE/DESI_DR2_wCDM.lean are the expressions evaluated by scripts/desi_dr2_bao/dr2_model.py with orad = 0: e_of_z = sqrt(om*zp1**3 + (1-om)*zp1**(3*(1+w))) and D_C = integral_0^z dt/E(t); hypotheses 0 < Om < 1 strictly contain the prior box [0.01, 0.99]. Reviewed by reading, not machine-checked; no independent auditor.
